meta.name: Tripwire Net
meta.description: Drives two stakes into the ground about sixty cells apart and strings a thin wire between them, a few cells up. It arms when your turn ends. The first tank to drive or fall into the wire, or the first shell to fly through it, snaps it: a weighted net drops where it was hit, banging hard and pinning every tank under it so it can't drive for two turns. A blast at either stake snaps it too.
